scientific_integrity: Analytical proof; companion symbolic/numerical tests are corroborative, not exhaustive or independent.
scientific_limitations: An explicit degree-minimal family with fixed finite circles, strictly monotone angular drift on them, no classification of noncircular global periodic orbits. The degree bound and one-circle quadratic criterion are already in prior literature; independent verification and complete historical priority are outstanding.
title: An exact orthogonality wall for minimal-degree concentric cycles
